# doctor-elwood-phd/mbedtls

Fork of Mbed-TLS/mbedtls. This fork carries one added document: an index of public integration-testing results for open Mbed TLS pull requests (snapshot 2026-11-12), with links to the coordination repo and caveats.

- [Integration results index](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/doctor-elwood-phd/mbedtls/development/integration-results.md): scope, numbers per branch and configuration, caveats
- [Agreed report outline](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Smellwood/mbedtls-integration-notes/main/report-outline.md)
- [3.6 tested-tree patch](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Smellwood/mbedtls-integration-notes/main/results/mbedtls-3.6/tested-tree.patch)
- [3.6 results README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Smellwood/mbedtls-integration-notes/main/results/mbedtls-3.6/README.md)
- [Coordination repo](https://github.com/Smellwood/mbedtls-integration-notes)
- [Upstream README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Mbed-TLS/mbedtls/development/README.md)
